title: How to Create a WhatsApp Broadcast Strategy for Your Laundry Business That Gets Responses

facts.fact: The blog states that the ideal WhatsApp broadcast call to action should take fewer than ten seconds to respond to.
facts.quote: a specific call to action that takes fewer than ten seconds to respond to

facts.fact: The blog states that for most Nigerian laundry businesses, the appropriate WhatsApp broadcast frequency is two to four broadcasts per month.
facts.quote: which for most Nigerian laundry businesses is two to four broadcasts per month

facts.fact: The blog's illustrative limited-time WhatsApp offer example uses a twenty percent discount on orders dropped off within a single week, with customers replying YES to reserve a slot.
facts.quote: a twenty percent discount on all orders dropped off this week only, with the reply YES to reserve your slot

facts.fact: CloudLaundry states its platform provides customer categorisation by order frequency, service type, and last order date for targeted WhatsApp broadcasts.
facts.quote: providing the customer categorisation by order frequency, service type, and last order date that enables the targeted broadcast
